items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: So Chris found a way. Come down there by Mike Teston and borrow him money to pay him off.

ctx.x: tall man. That's right. That man could play up some music. Woo! He had one of the sideway too. You know, not the big old head like Timber got. He wasn't old side too. He wasn't leaning over like that. And make you healthy Uphight too. Uphight too. Uphight. Uphight. yes ma'am it give you all the oppression in the world for y'all. Listen at the man play a bass. Come on Keith. And that time Old Horford put that light on that keyboard by the bed. Look that time yeah that time Old Horford was playing trample with him.…

Man that was some kick them did. See the musician done the thing there? The boy was in the truck doing that. You understand any of them? You'd get yourself in trouble for that. That's when they got the union. You'd do something like that. You'd just have no word trouble for the union. And them fellas would be taking money. They'd take your deposit you know. Well Chris Kelly, you'd do the same with it too. He would do that with it too? Yeah he'd done that with it. He'd done that too. Take deposit. When they go to…
Captain. Man. Cut. Man. What's the matter with you Buddy. Nothing. Captain. Man. I just had a little bad night.
